title: Una seña
desc: Reading a signal you are not sure is one
setting: Lucía has laughed at three things that were not funny. Marcos is watching you miss it.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.en: And do you always come on Thursdays?

options.es: Casi siempre. ¿Por qué, vas a estar?
options.en: Almost always. Why, are you going to be here?
options.feedback: You answered and handed the question back. That is exactly the size of step this moment takes.
True. It closes a door she opened, and she opened it on purpose.

options.en: I do not know, it depends on work.
options.feedback: Depende is a fine word and a terrible answer to this particular question.

options.es: Ah, entonces ahí nos vemos, si Dios quiere.
options.en: Ah, then see you there, God willing.
options.feedback: You gave her back her own hedge with a smile in it. Nobody has committed to anything and everybody knows what is happening.
Warm and correct. It does not quite play the game she just started.
Asking a hedge to explain itself is asking somebody to say the thing out loud. Not yet.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.en: And why do you ask so much?

options.es: Porque me gusta hablar con vos.
options.en: Because I like talking to you.
options.feedback: Said plainly, once, without a joke to hide behind. That is the moment and you took it.

options.en: The thing is I am curious.
options.feedback: A safe answer. She will accept it, and nothing will happen.

options.en: I do not ask that much.
options.feedback: Arguing with the observation loses the thing the observation was for.

options.es: Aquí me enseñaron a dar la vuelta. Esta vez no quise.
options.en: Here they taught me to go the long way round. This time I did not want to.
options.feedback: It shows you understand how the country talks and that you chose otherwise. That is the best possible answer.
Backing away from something that landed well. Do not apologise for it.
A shrug where the moment wanted an answer.
